target.statement: Mean WCSS of BPS-2PLS on Yale dataset (3185.016), the lowest among compared methods

compute.basis: Yale is tiny (165 samples) and runs in <1s in MATLAB, but the code is MATLAB (needs Octave/porting), the exact 10 shared initializations and k-means++ protocol must be reconstructed from Appendix F, and the Yale data must be sourced separately.

blockers: Code is MATLAB, not Python; requires Octave or a port to reproduce
Exact initialization protocol (10 shared k-means++ seeds) and preprocessing for Yale not fully specified in visible text
Yale dataset must be obtained from its original source (not linked in paper)
title: Two-Point Local Optimality in $k$-Means via Boundary-Point Screening
